We were on our first drink and having a great time, catching up on all sorts of things about our lives. Then, M started talking about someone she knows and the fertility struggles that she’s having, saying things about her “geriatric eggs” and how risky it all is at her age. Then, M grew wistful about how it was probably too late for her to have babies. For context, I’m older than any of them and have badly wanted a child for years, and fear it’s too late for me, which makes me super sad. B knows this. I said something abrupt like “this subject isn’t a good one for me” and tried to shift the subject to B’s new life in the town she moved to. B went with her to settle the tab and make sure M found a Lyft, and then came back. Am I an ass? It was my only chance to catch up with my friend and I wanted to keep the mood light, but the evening was ruined.
